title: [finding] a seat POINTER comment headed "Contract review of record" is indistinguishable at skim depth from a malformed record — it cost this seat a multi-round false non-conformance charge against a conforming clearance
body:
Filed by the `domain:cli` execution PM seat #6024 (`session_01QCdUBjM47SxioST9z5Zwdf`). ⛔ Filed bare — ⛔ no `domain:*`, ⛔ no `priority:*`, ⛔ no type: triage grades and routes. ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Not a ruling.

⏱️ Every rule line below was read first-hand on `origin/main` `eec56c37df`; every comment was read first-hand from the REST API. ⛔ Nothing is quoted from a report or from recall.

## The collision

`references/contract-review.md` defines a clause-② review of record and what discriminates one:

> `:27` 复核记录 = 一条评论落 PR 或卡,席内与子代理同形;散文、dev 自评、`os-dev-report` 恒不算。
> `:28` 同形 = `## Contract review` 题头、所审 head sha 独占码段、①②③ 逐项、独立性对、PASS/FAIL。
> `:29` 同形含首行 `Served-tier:`:值写常量名 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`;无此行不成裁决,模板见 `--template`。

That is a complete rule for a **reader who opens the comment**. It says nothing about what a comment may be **titled**, and the discriminator it names — `Served-tier:` on the first line — sits **below** the heading.

So a seat may correctly write a comment headed `## Contract review of record: **FAIL**` that is **not a record**: a pointer at the real one. Two such comments exist on card #18431, both written by this seat:

| comment | heading | what it actually is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `5747212041` | `## Contract review of record: **FAIL** — patch round opening…` | names record `5747199582` on PR #18962, its head, its verdict |
| `5747574143` | `## Contract review of record round 2: **FAIL** — …` | names record `5747563471`, its head, its verdict |

Neither carries a `Served-tier:` line. Neither carries a `**VERDICT:**` line. **Both are correct as written** — `:27` already excludes 散文 from counting, so nothing machine-read was misled. The defect is entirely at **skim depth**, and skim depth is where a seat re-reads its own thread months later.

## What the collision cost

The `domain:cli` seat's patrol prompt carried this standing item across many rounds, marked 「NOT YET FILED, and it is this seat's own defect」:

> PR #18962 / card #18431 (`domain:cli`, `Clause-②: yes`) was cleared against **in-seat** review-of-record comments, but `e15870f7a0` landed the lane rule **before** that — so that merged pair did what this lane may not. Record it on #18431; ⛔ do not quietly reuse it as precedent.

It was measured for the first time this round and **withdrawn** — every limb of it is false. The four real records live on the **PR** thread (`:27` sanctions 「PR 或卡」), all four open *"Isolated at-tier review of record"*, all four carry the full `:28`/`:29` shape, and the clearing PASS `5749558880` names `Head-sha: b8e08ec2fb6b0af4818b839766be95672d4897ed` — the exact sha PR #18962 merged at. The withdrawal, with the full measurement, is on #18431.

⭐ The charge was built from the **headings** of `5747212041` and `5747574143`. Nothing else on either thread reads as an in-seat review, because nothing else is one.

⇒ the cost was not a wrong merge. It was a **false non-conformance charge standing against a conforming clearance**, carried forward round after round in the one artefact a successor seat inherits verbatim. A successor acting on it would have refused a precedent that is sound.

## What this card asks

A naming discipline, ⛔ not a gate.

- The heading `## Contract review` is **reserved for the record**. A comment that points at a record, relays one, or opens a patch round on one is headed something else — and names the record's comment id in its own opening line, which both of the two above already do.
- One line beside `:27` saying so, so the exclusion covers the **title** and not only what counts.

⛔ Deliberately **not** asked for: a new gate, a new `--pair` row, or a ratchet. Ruling batch #208 item 1 (record `5755284987`, maintainer accepted) is explicit — R6: 「hard gates only for definite questions; guessing instruments report-only; a new gate / row / ratchet needs the maintainer's sentence」. "Is this heading a record or a pointer?" is answerable by opening the comment, so no reader is guessing; the failure was a seat that did not open it. Text is the proportionate remedy.

## ⚠️ One measurement trap, recorded because this seat fell into it first

Opening the investigation, this seat measured `5747212041` and `5747574143` **against the record template** and found they carry neither `Served-tier:` nor `**VERDICT:**` — and briefly took that for a third and sharper finding ("the records are malformed"). It is not a finding at all: they are not records, so the template does not apply to them. ⇒ ⭐ **measuring an artefact against a contract it was never under produces a clean-looking failure**, and the heading is exactly what invites the wrong contract to be picked.
